card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The blank space (or a dollar sign) right after a drug name or 'with' and just before a dose number such as 400 mg or 100 mg. It is mostly seen in HIV antiretroviral dosing tables.

modes.label: Space before a dose
modes.description: The space between an HIV drug name and its dose amount.

modes.label: Repeated dose rows
modes.description: The space before a repeated dose entry in a regimen list.

modes.label: Price amount
modes.description: A dollar sign before a large price figure.

card.writes: It seems to suppress word starts like pivot, augmented and simplex, so the next token is more likely a number.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a dose number that follows an HIV drug name.
